summary: We developed LIFE: Beyond Earth, an intelligent agricultural management platform designed to assist farmers through four integrated stages. The system begins with user authentication, allowing farmers to upload land imagery and define boundaries before entering detailed land specifications—including plot number, area, GPS coordinates, soil type, crop history (past and current yields), and their farming objective (commercial or self-sufficiency). The platform also provides an estimated land valuation and connects users to global real estate marketplaces if they choose to sell. Finally, an integrated AI advisor analyzes all entered data to send proactive alerts regarding frost, humidity, extreme heat, and fertilization needs, while offering an interactive Q&A assistant. By transforming fragmented farming practices into a centralized, data-driven workflow, the project addresses unpredictable weather risks, poor crop rotation, and complex land valuation. Ultimately, it is important because it empowers farmers to make informed decisions that maximize crop yield, protect soil health, minimize financial losses, and promote sustainable food security.  All the data was used, but there is no time to select it in the field below in its entirety.
details: LIFE: Beyond Earth is a smart agricultural management platform designed to assist farmers through four integrated stages. The workflow begins with user authentication, where farmers log in to their existing accounts or create a new one, with the optional step to upload an image of their land and define its boundaries and area. Next, users register specific land details, including the plot number, land area and unit of measurement, location (entered manually or selected via GPS), and soil type, alongside crop data covering currently planted and previously planted crops. Once saved, a summary of the entered land details appears at the bottom of the screen, with the option to add multiple lands. Farmers can also choose whether they want to sell their land; if they opt to sell, the system calculates an estimated price based on the registered area, provides options for global real estate platforms to list the land, and allows the farmer to provide their email address so interested buyers can contact them directly, while still permitting them to save the data and add more lands. Finally, based on all the entered information, an integrated AI assistant sends proactive alerts warning the farmer of upcoming frost, humidity, or extreme heat, identifies fertilization needs, provides actionable solutions for these conditions, and answers any additional questions the farmer may have. The platform was developed using PHP, HTML, and CSS for building the user interfaces and backend logic, alongside leveraging AI tools during the coding and development process.
